**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +49.72%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +21.91%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Healthcare also strong: NUE (1W: +13.01% | 1M: +33.85%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Technology shows internal strength but mixed signals: AAPL (1W: +2.53% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +13.03%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +15.29%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +9.43% | 1M: -7.10%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Tech: 14/24 positive — Internal Rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed: UNH (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND and ABT (1W: -9.71% | 1M: -11.99%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 6/17 positive — Internal Rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed strength (AMD, ORCL, UNH) and reduce exposure to structurally weak Industrials and lagging consumer/high-multiple names (NFLX, ABT, GE). Style: mixed — be selective given narrow/concentrated leadership and stock-level divergences.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**

DHR (+60): Danaher bullish headline but price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -2.93%) — clear divergence, monitor for distribution vs accumulation. **15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
Top negative headlines include MRK (-80), F (-60) and GM (-60) but those names are not in today's price feed for dual-timeframe cross-check in this brief; for price-validated negative setups in our feed see QCOM/COF/ASML mentions in broader news lists — monitor external price data for confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +49.72%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +21.91%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: multiple large-cap divergences (NOW RECOVERY, PLTR RECOVERY, SCHW bullish news but BELOW TREND) — watch for trend confirmation before expanding directional exposure.
